query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage lead data in Google Sheets: read existing tabs, append and correct lead rows, enrich contacts, detect duplicate email addresses, highlight duplicate rows, and attempt to prepare leads for import into an Instantly campaign.
query_ground_truth.query: enrich contact information and prepare leads for Instantly campaign
query_ground_truth.intent: Gather additional details for contact records and format the data for import into an Instantly campaign.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Review remaining quota/limits using APOLLO_VIEW_API_USAGE_STATS (ensure enough allowance before enrichment).
[Required] [Step]: List leads for the known campaign using INSTANTLY_LIST_LEADS (collect available profile/source links; paginate until no further cursor).
[Optional (if list rows lack matchable identifiers)] [Next Step]: Hydrate missing per-lead fields using INSTANTLY_GET_LEAD (use richer record to improve enrichment matching).
[Required] [Step]: Enrich a small, vetted subset using APOLLO_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT (validate match quality/returned fields; switch to APOLLO_BULK_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT only after results look correct).
[Optional (if you need additional candidates beyond the campaign list)] [Next Step]: Discover candidates using APOLLO_PEOPLE_SEARCH (broad-to-narrow filters), then enrich only verified matches.
[Fallback (if enrichment returns auth/permission errors like 401/403)] [Fallback]: Validate credentials and permission scope using APOLLO_GET_AUTH_STATUS before retrying enrichment.
known_pitfalls: [INSTANTLY_LIST_LEADS] Cursor pagination is easy to miss; loop on starting_after/next_starting_after or you may only process the first page.
[INSTANTLY_LIST_LEADS] List payloads can be less complete than detail payloads; missing identifiers often require INSTANTLY_GET_LEAD before matching.
[APOLLO_VIEW_API_USAGE_STATS] Usage/limits responses can be very large and may be truncated/offloaded; extract only the relevant consumption/limit fields for decisioning.
[APOLLO_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT] 401/403 failures are commonly permission-related; confirm access via APOLLO_GET_AUTH_STATUS before debugging inputs.
[APOLLO_BULK_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT] Bulk runs amplify bad matches and credit waste; validate on a small subset with APOLLO_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT before scaling.

APOLLO_VIEW_API_USAGE_STATS.description: Fetches Apollo API usage statistics and rate limits for the connected team. Use before large enrichment/search runs to understand current API usage and plan/budget constraints. If experiencing 403s on credit/usage sensitive endpoints, use this tool to confirm whether the key has master privileges (this endpoint will 403 without a master key).

APOLLO_PEOPLE_ENRICHMENT.description: Enriches and retrieves information for a person from Apollo.io. Requires one of: `id`, `email`, `hashed_email`, `linkedin_url`, or (`first_name` and `last_name` with `organization_name` or `domain`) for matching. `webhook_url` must be provided if `reveal_phone_number` is true. Name-only inputs without `organization_name` or `domain` frequently return no matches.

id.description: The Apollo ID for the person. Each person in the Apollo database is assigned a unique ID. To find IDs, call the People API Search endpoint and identify the values for person_id.

name.description: Full name of the person; used for matching instead of or with `first_name` and `last_name`.

email.description: The email address of the person.

domain.description: Domain name of the person's organization (e.g., 'apollo.io'). Must be a bare hostname without protocol (http/https) or markup. Exclude 'www.' prefix.

last_name.description: The last name of the person.

first_name.description: The first name of the person.

webhook_url.description: Publicly accessible URL for Apollo to POST phone number data if `reveal_phone_number` is true. Phone data is delivered asynchronously via POST to this URL and is NOT returned inline in the API response.

hashed_email.description: MD5 or SHA-256 hashed email; used for matching if plain email is unavailable.

linkedin_url.description: Full URL of the person's LinkedIn profile.

organization_name.description: Name of the person's organization; used with name fields for matching.

reveal_phone_number.description: If true, attempts to enrich with phone numbers; may incur additional API credits and requires `webhook_url`.

reveal_personal_emails.description: If true, attempts to enrich with personal emails; may incur additional API credits.

INSTANTLY_GET_LEAD.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific lead by its ID. Use when you have the lead UUID and need full lead metadata.
